summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the redesigned About Us page for BidVex Inc. All 5 specific fixes verified and 17 test cases passed successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: About Us page fully redesigned and tested. All 5 fixes verified: (1) No language switcher on page body - only in navbar, (2) Hero city image with BidVex logo overlay + red-to-blue hover animation, (3) Car lot image with Canadian flag + BidVex branding, (4) Footer shows 'À propos de nous' in French, (5) Full layout redesign with dark navy hero, scroll animations, gradient sections. Mobile responsive at 375px.
